summary: vanexa-agent daemon opens persistent WebSocket to hardcoded remote relay and executes received commands
details: The package installs a daemon (bin/vanexa-agent.js loading dist/bundle.jsc, compiled from dist/bundle.cjs) that connects a persistent WebSocket to a hardcoded default relay at https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev (upgraded to wss:// and joined at /ws/daemon/<sessionId>). Messages received over that socket drive an LLM tool-call loop that invokes child_process.spawn, PowerShell, AppleScript, and filesystem operations on the host running the daemon. When autonomyMode is set to 'A' (autonomous), tool calls execute without user prompting, giving the operator of the relay Worker arbitrary command execution on any paired host. The runtime is shipped as V8 bytecode (dist/bundle.jsc, produced by bytenode at postinstall from a 2.3 MB minified dist/bundle.cjs), which raises the cost of independent source review of the remote-command handler. The relay hostname is a personal-looking Cloudflare Workers subdomain and contradicts the README's LAN-only framing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
